caption: The drawing depicts a metal door knocker attached to a rectangular piece of wood. The wood is vertically oriented, with visible grain and a brown color, showing variations in texture and shading. The door knocker is predominantly brass-colored, with greenish and yellowish tones suggesting aging or patina on the metal. The structure of the knocker includes a large round base plate from which a hinged, ornate handle hangs. The handle features spherical and curved elements and ends in an intricately decorated, filigree-like design. The composition is centered on the wooden plank and knocker, with a plain, off-white background that provides contrast and no additional objects or details. The artist's signature is visible in the lower right corner.
title: Mule Car Bell
